parameters.query:
WITH run AS (
  INSERT INTO engine_runs (engine, session_id, sender, input, output, risk_level, status)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6, $7)
  RETURNING id
), new_tasks AS (
  INSERT INTO emma_tasks (title, source_engine, run_id)
  SELECT t, $1, (SELECT id FROM run) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($8::jsonb) AS t
  RETURNING 1
), new_leads AS (
  INSERT INTO crm_leads (name, email, phone, company, status, interest_score, context)
  SELECT c->>'name', c->>'email', c->>'phone', c->>'company', 'new',
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(c->>'score', ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::int, $9
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($10::jsonb) AS c
  RETURNING 1
), approval AS (
  INSERT INTO emma_approvals (run_id, engine, reason)
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM run), $1, $9 WHERE $6 = 'HIGH'
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM run) AS run_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM new_tasks) AS tasks_created,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM new_leads) AS leads_created,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM approval) AS approvals_created;
